gates.terrainContinuity: pass shared canonical vertices/normals and finite field; local slope is measured separately
gates.hydrology: conditional: seven original large depressions removed; review small residual depressions, watershed fidelity and fine bed ripples
gates.coast: conditional: clipped water interfaces verified; inspect rocky mouth transitions and measured coast exceptions
gates.geomorphology: not fully accepted: continuity improves, but smooth flanks, constrained inlet shoulders and weak secondary landforms remain visible
gates.traversability: centreline and runtime results below; full widths not accepted where transverse slope fails
gates.visualQuality: matched eight-view review required; no automatic art acceptance
gates.regression: source master, coast/lake/channel curves and regional identities retained; ridge elevations are constrained lower bounds, deviations measured
gates.technical: tests/build/reproducibility pass; actual browser controls recorded; no physical Android validation
